en_us.pa.pause_unloaded.desc: The particle has entered an$unloaded chunk. The operation has$been suspended, until both the$particle and the particle source$are loaded.
en_us.pa.crash_defocus.desc: The particle has lost focus.$Ensure the accelerator has enough quadrupole magnets.
en_us.pa.crash_derail.desc: The particle has left the accelerator.$Ensure no parts are missing,$and that dipoles are configured correctly.
en_us.pa.crash_cannot_enter.desc: The particle tried to enter$part of the accelerator, but couldn't.$Ensure all parts are oriented correctly.
en_us.pa.crash_nocool.desc: The particle has entered an uncooled$part of the accelerator. Ensure all cooled$parts are connected and filled$with cold perfluoromethyl.
en_us.pa.crash_nopower.desc: The particle has entered an unpowered$part of the accelerator. Ensure all parts$receive power, and that the$power supply is sufficient.
en_us.pa.crash_nocoil.desc: The particle has entered a dipole$or quadrupole which lacks coils.$Install coils to allow this part to work.
en_us.pa.crash_overspeed.desc: The particle has entered a dipole$or quadrupole, while its speed exceeded$the coil's rating. Install higher$tier coils, or configure the dipoles$to leave the accelerator ring sooner.
en_us.pa.crash_norecipe.desc: The particle entered a detector$with an invalid set of inputs.$Ensure the particle source inputs$match a valid recipe.
en_us.pa.crash_underspeed.desc: The particle entered a detector$with insufficient speed to perform$the current recipe. Ensure the$accelerator is configured$correctly for the recipe.
en_us.tile.pa_detector.name: Particle Detector
en_us.tile.pa_detector.desc: Requires cooling!$Accepts particles and performs the recipe.$Recipes may require containers (particle capsules).$Particle needs a defocus of 0 to be accepted.
en_us.tile.pa_dipole.name: Dipole Magnets
en_us.tile.pa_dipole.desc: Requires cooling!$Redirects particles based on momentum.$Has outputs for below threshold,$above threshold and above threshold$with redstone applied.$Requires large coils to work.
en_us.tile.pa_quadrupole.name: Quadrupole Magnets
en_us.tile.pa_quadrupole.desc: Requires cooling!$Reduces particle defocus by 100 points.$Requires large coils to work.
en_us.tile.pa_rfc.name: RF Cavity
en_us.tile.pa_rfc.desc: Requires cooling!$Accelerates particles by 100 points,$and adds 100 points of defocus.$The particle will crash when reaching points of 1000 defocus.
en_us.tile.pa_source.name: Particle Source
en_us.tile.pa_source.desc: Requires cooling!$Uses two items to create a particle.

zh_cn.tile.pa_detector.name: 粒子探测器
zh_cn.tile.pa_dipole.name: 双极磁铁
zh_cn.tile.pa_quadrupole.name: 四极磁铁

zh_cn.tile.pa_source.name: 粒子源
zh_cn.pa.pause_unloaded.desc: 粒子进入了未加载的区块。$在粒子与粒子源均被加载前，运行将暂停。
zh_cn.pa.crash_defocus.desc: 粒子失焦。$请确保加速器含有足够数量的四极磁铁。
zh_cn.pa.crash_derail.desc: 粒子离开加速器。$请确保加速器未缺失部件，$且所有双极磁铁均正确配置。
zh_cn.pa.crash_cannot_enter.desc: 粒子尝试进入加速器某部件时失败。$请确保所有部件朝向正确。
zh_cn.pa.crash_nocool.desc: 粒子进入了未冷却的加速器部件。$请确保所有需冷却的部件正常连接，且内部含有冷四氟甲烷。
zh_cn.pa.crash_nopower.desc: 粒子进入了未供能的加速器部件。$请确保所有部件均接受供电且供电充足。
zh_cn.pa.crash_nocoil.desc: 粒子进入了缺少线圈的双极磁铁或四极磁铁。$请安装线圈，以使上述部件正常工作。
zh_cn.pa.crash_overspeed.desc: 粒子进入某双极磁铁或四极磁铁时，$其速度超出了内部线圈接受的最大速度。$请安装更高等级的线圈，$或调整双极磁铁设定以使粒子提前离开加速区域。
zh_cn.tile.pa_detector.desc: 需要冷却！$接收粒子并进行配方$配方可能需要容器（粒子胶囊）$粒子的失焦程度需要为0才能被接收
zh_cn.tile.pa_dipole.desc: 需要冷却！$根据粒子动量使其转向$具有“低于阈值”、“高于阈值”、$“高于阈值且收到红石信号”三种设置$需要大型线圈才能工作
zh_cn.tile.pa_quadrupole.desc: 需要冷却！$使粒子失焦程度减少100$需要大型线圈才能工作
zh_cn.tile.pa_rfc.desc: 需要冷却！$使粒子动量增加100，并使粒子失焦程度增加100$粒子失焦程度到达1000时会坍毁
zh_cn.tile.pa_source.desc: 需要冷却！$使用两个物品来创造一个粒子
zh_cn.pa.crash_norecipe.desc: 粒子进入了检测器，但输入的粒子不与任何配方匹配。$请确保向粒子源输入的粒子符合正确的配方。
zh_cn.pa.crash_underspeed.desc: 粒子进入了检测器，但其速度不足以进行此配方。$请确保加速器已为该配方正确配置。
